key_points: WDC beat earnings and raised guidance, but shares declined, highlighting lingering memory-cycle and competitor concerns.
Recent AI-memory rally lifted beaten-down names including WDC, but the rebound appears sentiment-driven and mixed.
Analyst coverage remains divided, with comparisons to IBM and debates against Sandisk offering no clear near-term resolution.
Valuation concerns and macro pressure from inflation and higher rates add caution despite strong AI storage demand.
Overall headlines create a neutral near-term backdrop; long-term thesis may remain intact but requires clearer catalysts.
